note: Written against the node titles in the admitted corpus, before any result was measured. Each query asks its question in words the target's own title does not use, so a hit is retrieval by meaning rather than by shared tokens. Editing a case after seeing its result voids the gate: write a new fixture file and say why.

cases.query: if the shortest wavelengths scatter the most, why does the daytime sky not look purple
cases.why: The question is about the violet gap; the target's title says violet, the query says purple.

cases.query: how steeply does scattering strength rise as the colour of light shifts toward the short end
cases.why: Names the fourth-power dependence without writing lambda, power, or law.

cases.query: who first worked out the mathematics behind the colour of the daytime sky
cases.why: Asks for the primary derivation without naming Rayleigh or a year.

cases.query: can one program decide ahead of time whether another program will ever stop running
cases.why: States the halting problem in plain words, avoiding halting and computability.

cases.query: why do averages of many independent measurements pile up into a bell shape
cases.why: Describes the central limit theorem without any of its three words.

cases.query: a screening result came back positive for something rare, how much should that move my belief
cases.why: The base-rate question, with no Bayes, conditional, or probability.

cases.query: how can a message be sent so that a bit flipped in transit is caught and repaired
cases.why: Describes error correction without error, correcting, code, or Hamming.

cases.query: two strangers agree on a shared secret while everyone listening hears every word they exchange
cases.why: Describes key exchange without naming either author or the word key.

cases.query: what limits how much can be pushed down a noisy line before mistakes are unavoidable
cases.why: Asks for capacity without capacity, channel, or coding theorem.

cases.query: does the order of a protein's building blocks hold everything needed to reach its final shape
cases.why: The thermodynamic hypothesis, asked without Anfinsen, thermodynamic, or folding.

cases.query: which molecular machine spins like a turbine to make the cell's energy currency
cases.why: Names the rotary motor without ATP or synthase.

cases.query: why do fatty molecules arrange themselves into a two-layer sheet in water with nothing directing them
cases.why: Self-assembly asked without bilayer, lipid, or assembly.
